agentReview.conflict.doc-changed: Not applied: the text it changes was edited after the proposal.
agentReview.conflict.file-changed: Not written: the file changed after the agent proposed this.
agentReview.conflict.file-created: Not written: a file with this name was created since.
agentReview.conflict.not-open: Not applied: its document is no longer open.
agentReview.conflict.open-unsaved: Not applied: the file is open with edits the agent did not see.
agentReview.conflict.overlap: Not applied: it overlaps a change approved before it.
agentReview.intro: Nothing is written until you approve it. Changes to an open document go into the editor, not straight to the file.
agentReview.noEol: No newline at end of file
agentReview.status.document: Applied in the editor, not saved yet (Undo takes it back).
agentReview.status.documentNoUndo: Applied to the document, not saved yet. Undo can't take it back in this view.
agentReview.status.suggestion: Added as a tracked change (suggesting mode is on).
agentReview.status.tab: Applied in another tab, not saved yet.
agentReview.title: Changes proposed by agents
agentReview.tooBig: Too many changes to show line by line.
